scripts.build:js: terser plugin/kalambeer.js -o plugin/kalambeer.min.js && terser example/main.js -o example/main.min.js
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css
scripts.watch:js: onchange plugin/kalambeer.js example/main.js -- npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently "npm run start" "npm run watch:js" "npm run watch:css"
